description:
Short title
LLM drafts training quiz questions

What should the AI do?
An LLM writes draft multiple-choice questions for the read-and-understand training that follows an SOP revision. The questions are based on the revised SOP text. The training coordinator loads them into the learning management system for operators.

Where will it be used?
Manufacturing / production, QA / quality systems

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
No, only indirectly. Training material only; it does not touch a batch, record, QC result or release.

What kind of AI is it?
Generative AI: writes or creates text, images or code (LLM). A general-purpose chatbot.

What happens with the output?
A trained person checks and approves each output before it is used

Who checks the output, and how?
QA receives it

Does the AI replace or reduce a check or step that people do today?
No, everything done today stays; the AI adds to it

What data goes into it?
Internal, not confidential

Who provides it?
Cloud or online service

citations.quote: Where a model is used to give an input to a decision made by a human operator (human-in-the-loop), and where the effort to test such model has been diminished, the description of the intended use should include the responsibility of the operator.

judgments.label: GMP, non-critical
judgments.rationale: The LLM generates draft training quiz questions for SOP revisions, which support training workflows rather than having a direct impact on patient safety, product quality, or data integrity.

judgments.label: Generative AI / LLM
judgments.rationale: The system uses an LLM to write and create text content based on SOP documents.

judgments.label: AI recommends, human approves each output
judgments.rationale: The AI generates proposed quiz questions, and a qualified person reviews and approves each output before it is loaded into the learning management system.

open_questions: What specific prompt instructions and validation checks are used by QA to ensure the generated quiz questions accurately and comprehensively reflect the critical requirements of the revised SOP?
Who checks each output before it is used, against what, and where is the check recorded?
